headline: After backlash, Meta pauses plan to ‘rate limit’ its smart glasses
summary: Meta paused its controversial $20 monthly subscription plan for smart glasses. The fee was for an audio clarity feature, despite it running locally on the device. Backlash from users prompted the company's decision.

headline: Meta just created a moderation nightmare for its smart glasses
summary: Meta's smart glasses are fueling privacy concerns and surveillance fears. Some users are filming unsuspecting strangers for 'prank' content, particularly targeting women. This has created a significant PR and moderation challenge for Meta.

headline: Qualcomm is about to raise prices and that’s bad news for everyone
summary: Qualcomm plans to increase product prices by a double-digit percentage. The price hikes will apply to products shipped after September 1st. The company cites absorbing higher supplier costs amid ongoing component shortages.

headline: Midjourney bought the astrology app Co-Star
summary: AI startup Midjourney, known for image generation, has acquired the astrology app Co-Star. Co-Star offers personalized daily horoscopes and social astrology features. This acquisition marks Midjourney's expansion into a new field.

headline: San Diego Comic-Con 2026: Everything Announced So Far | Comic Con 2026
summary: San Diego Comic-Con 2026 is underway with major announcements expected. Live coverage will feature exclusive reveals and interviews. Content spans movies, shows, comics, games, anime, and collectibles.

headline: Paramount and Warner Bros. Deal Officially Paused, Could Be on Hold Until June 2027
summary: Paramount has officially postponed its merger deal with Warner Bros. The pause is due to an ongoing antitrust trial. The deal could remain on hold until June 2027.

headline: Aaron Pierre Reveals Grisly Bicep Injury That Nearly Cost Him Lanterns Role
summary: Aaron Pierre sustained a severe bicep injury just months before filming Lanterns. The injury almost cost him the role of John Stewart in HBO's Lanterns series. Pierre shared details about the harrowing experience.

headline: Don't Play Halo: Campaign Evolved on Steam Deck or Xbox Ally
summary: Halo: Campaign Evolved performs poorly on handhelds like Steam Deck and Xbox Ally. The game exhibits worse image quality than the older Master Chief Collection on these devices. It's recommended to play the Master Chief Collection instead for handheld Halo.

headline: Firefighters struggle to contain Madrid wildfires, as more than 140,000 evacuated in France and Spain
summary: Madrid faces its "worst fire in history," with firefighters battling intense wildfires. Blazes are also raging in France, particularly near Bordeaux. Over 140,000 people have been evacuated across both countries.

headline: Law student is charged over intercepted bomb in car
summary: A law student, Isobella Perrie Sullivan, has been charged after a bomb was found in her car. Her lawyer states she was unaware the bag contained an explosive device. The bomb was intercepted by authorities.

headline: Watch moment of explosion as huge fire breaks out in Essex
summary: A massive fire erupted at industrial units on an Essex farm. Over 100 firefighters were deployed to tackle the blaze. Video footage captured the moment of an explosion during the incident.

headline: Man describes trying to save mother and daughter who drowned off Essex beach
summary: Craig Bowe recounted his attempt to save a mother and daughter from drowning. The tragic incident occurred off an Essex beach during his daughter's birthday trip. He heard screams and rushed to help, but was unsuccessful.
